schema: LAISE TUK2 Objective Candidate Selection v1.0
selection_scope: Four objective representative 20-second windows rendered from all 12 stems through dearVR PRO 2 using identical staging.

common_input_gain.policy: Identical conservative staging for all candidates; no candidate-specific normalization or loudness advantage.

trajectory_component.reason: Full technical 360/180/elevation validation is inherited equally. No musical full orbit is forced solely to gain score.

windows.interpretation: Technical proxies; masking index is not intelligibility measurement, pair score is not a human discrimination probability.

decision_policy: Highest locked weighted objective score. No subjective promotion and no recency bonus.
epistemic_limits: Scores are engineering proxies and are not human perceptual probabilities.
Front/back and elevation classification use controlled broadband reference models; musical stems are a domain shift.
T006B selects a provisional architecture from representative actual binaural renders. The winner must still pass independent full-song QA.
Distance remains a control parameter and is not treated as proof of perceived near-field depth.
next_stage: Render provisional winner for the entire 330-second timeline and independently validate all sections before mastering.
